Also data mode can set individual elements. next example, global mode integer , sub-argument foo mode f bar inherits global one. data mode specified global level, every individual sub-argument explicitely specify data mode. Similarly, constraints sub-argument can set follows, constraints set names allowed sub-arguments (allows numeric constraints). Sub-argument allows alias names. restriction name . title: Dispatching to sub-commands
text: script gets complicated, better split several sub-scripts focused specific task. sub_commands() supports dispatch command-line arguments sub-scripts. following code gives quick example sub commands set. function sub_commands(), name sub-command, sub-script description sub-command organized 3-tuple. following code put script called main.R (parent script) contains dispatches sub-commands. Code sub1.R: code sub2.R: Calling main.R argument prints list sub-commands supports. sub-command called, corresponding R script invoked. command-line arguments sub-command sub1 go correspond R script sub1.R. Internally, executes Rscript sub1.R --help. Command-line arguments sub1.R can directly put sub-command sub1, internally equivalent Rscript sub1.R --foo 10. shebang line can added first line parent R script, Rscript necessary explicitely called. Also .R suffix parent script can removed pretend linux utility program. Make sure main executable. directory script main put PATH sub-command scripts accessible main,
code: library(argitect)  sub_commands(     "sub1", "sub1.R", "Description of sub command 1.",     "sub2", "sub2.R", "Description of sub command 2." ) library(argitect)  argitect("foo=i", "Set value for foo.")  cat("foo is ", foo, "\n") library(argitect)  argitect("bar=i", "Set value for bar")  cat("bar is ", bar, "\n") ~\> Rscript main.R Usage: Rscript main.R [command] [options]  Commands:   sub1    Description of sub command 1.   sub2    Description of sub command 2. ~\> Rscript main.R sub1 --help Usage: Rscript main.R sub1 [options]  Options:   --foo, -f integer     Set value for foo.    --help, -h     Print help message and exit.    --version, -v     Print version information and exit. ~\> Rscript main.R sub1 --foo 10 foo is 10 #!/usr/bin/env Rscript library(argitect)  sub_commands(     "sub1", "sub1.R", "This is sub-command 1.",     "sub2", "sub2.R", "This is sub-command 2." ) ./main sub1 --foo 1 main sub1 --foo 1

title: Parse command-line arguments — argitect
text: argument specification name[|alias...]=spec. value part spec consists optional mode (integer, f numeric, s character, l logical) optional type ($ scalar, # positional, @ vector, % hash), optionally followed bracketed range sub-argument list. mode also accepts extended integer notation: 0x/0X hexadecimal, 0b/0B binary, 0/0o/0O octal (e.g. 0123), decimal. Examples : "number=": single integer scalar. "name=s": single character scalar. "length|size=": integer scalar two names. "tag=@": integer vector. "tag=@{2,}": integer vector least two elements. "param=s%": name=value pairs character values. "input=s#": one positional argument. "files=s#{}": one positional arguments. "verbose!": logical option, negatable ---verbose. variable first name already exists envir (function), used default value option becomes optional. Logical options always default FALSE. details, please refer vignette.

title: Get or set global options for argitect() — argitect_options
text: Supported options: config character vector parser configuration flags (default c("bundling", "no_ignore_case")). following values recognized: "bundling": allow single-letter flags combined, -abc --b -c (default behavior). "no_bundling": disable bundling; -abc treated single (unknown) option named abc. "ignore_case": match long option names case-insensitively, --FOO matches --foo (default matching case-sensitive). "no_ignore_case": keep case-sensitive matching; "ignore_case" "no_ignore_case" given, latter wins. example argitect_options("config" = c("ignore_case", "no_bundling")). template_tag tag identifying specifications template, format "left_tag CODE right_tag" (default "<CODE>"). help_style style help message: "one-column" "two-column". help_width width help message, vector one two numbers (default c(90, 40)). first number total width; one-column style uses . second number width first (option) column used two-column style. Option names long wrapped, continuation lines aligned second option name. value_sep separator used split multiple values inside single name=value pair vector sub-argument. default "auto" automatically detects separator among ",", ";", ":", "|" "/" picking one satisfies type count constraints. argitect_options(...) put calling argitect() sub_commands().
